diff_shrink_note: run-differential shrink fitted by log loss on completed games; below 1.0 means the raw predictor separated clubs further than the results did, and the fair total is untouched by it
home_field_note: the runs regression recovers almost no home field because a home team leading after the top of the ninth never bats; the adjustment restores the observed home win rate as a run differential, leaving the fair total unchanged
source_note: fit on completed games read out of .cache/game_feeds, offline; team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so this fit is IN-SAMPLE and cannot validate the model
